mapper.select: SELECT id FROM cps_recon_guard WHERE id = 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM cps_recon_source WHERE platform=#{platform} AND source_type=#{sourceType} AND external_id=#{externalId}
SELECT FROM cps_recon_source WHERE source_type=#{sourceType} AND external_id=#{externalId} AND source_type IN ('UNION_RECEIPT','PAYOUT')

SELECT FROM cps_recon_source WHERE platform=#{platform} AND ( (source_type IN ('UNION_REPORT','UNION_RECEIPT') AND ( EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cps_recon_source touched WHERE touched.platform=cps_recon_source.platform AND touched.order_no=cps_recon_source.order_no AND touched.sub_order_no=cps_recon_source.sub_order_no AND touched.source_type IN ('UNION_REPORT','UNION_RECEIPT') AND touched.occurred_on >= #{from} AND touched.occurred_on < #{until}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys_order_commission o WHERE o.platform_type=cps_recon_source.platform AND o.order_id=cps_recon_source.order_no AND o.sub_order_no=cps_recon_source.sub_order_no AND o.settle_time >= #{from} AND o.settle_time < #{until}))) OR (source_type='PAYOUT' AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cps_recon_source touched WHERE touched.platform='PAYOUT' AND touched.source_type='PAYOUT' AND touched.withdraw_no=cps_recon_source.withdraw_no AND touched.occurred_on >= #{from} AND touched.occurred_on < #{until}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cps_withdrawal w WHERE w.withdraw_no=cps_recon_source.withdraw_no AND w.status='SUCCEEDED' AND w.completed_at >= #{from} AND w.completed_at < #{until}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys_commission_flow f WHERE f.business_id=cps_recon_source.withdraw_no AND (f.credit_account='PAYOUT' OR f.debit_account='PAYOUT') AND f.create_time >= #{from} AND f.create_time < #{until}))) ) ORDER BY id
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) FROM cps_recon_coverage WHERE receipt_id=#{receiptId}

SELECT p.platform,p.order_line_id,p.order_no,p.sub_order_no,p.credited, LEAST(p.credited,GREATEST(COALESCE(c.covered,0),0),GREATEST(COALESCE(r.cash,0),0)) AS covered, GREATEST(COALESCE(r.cash,0)-COALESCE(c.covered,0),0) AS unallocated_cash, GREATEST(p.credited-LEAST(p.credited,GREATEST(COALESCE(c.covered,0),0),GREATEST(COALESCE(r.cash,0),0)),0) AS exposure FROM ( SELECT COALESCE(o.platform_type,'UNKNOWN') AS platform, COALESCE(o.id,-f.id) AS order_line_id, COALESCE(o.order_id,CONCAT('flow:',f.id)) AS order_no, COALESCE(o.sub_order_no,'') AS sub_order_no, GREATEST(SUM(CASE WHEN f.credit_account='USER_AVAILABLE' AND f.debit_account IN ('USER_FROZEN','REBATE_COST','REWARD_COST') THEN ABS(f.amount) WHEN f.debit_account='USER_AVAILABLE' AND f.credit_account IN ('REBATE_COST','REWARD_COST','USER_FROZEN') THEN -ABS(f.amount) WHEN f.debit_account IS NULL AND f.credit_account IS NULL AND (f.flow_type IN ('income_self','income_promotion','refund_self','refund_promotion') OR (f.flow_type='reversal' AND original.flow_type IN ('income_self','income_promotion'))) THEN f.amount ELSE 0 END),0) AS credited FROM sys_commission_flow f LEFT JOIN sys_commission_flow original ON original.id=f.original_flow_id LEFT JOIN sys_order_commission o ON o.id=COALESCE(f.order_commission_id, CASE WHEN f.related_order_id REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST(f.related_order_id AS UNSIGNED) ELSE NULL END, original.order_commission_id, CASE WHEN original.related_order_id REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST(original.related_order_id AS UNSIGNED) ELSE NULL END) WHERE (f.credit_account='USER_AVAILABLE' OR f.debit_account='USER_AVAILABLE' OR (f.debit_account IS NULL AND f.credit_account IS NULL AND (f.flow_type IN ('income_self','income_promotion','refund_self','refund_promotion') OR (f.flow_type='reversal' AND original.flow_type IN ('income_self','income_promotion'))))) GROUP BY COALESCE(o.platform_type,'UNKNOWN'),COALESCE(o.id,-f.id),COALESCE(o.order_id,CONCAT('flow:',f.id)),COALESCE(o.sub_order_no,'') ) p LEFT JOIN ( SELECT s.platform,s.order_no,s.sub_order_no,SUM(c.amount) AS covered FROM cps_recon_coverage c JOIN cps_recon_source s ON s.id=c.receipt_id GROUP BY s.platform,s.order_no,s.sub_order_no ) c ON c.platform=p.platform AND c.order_no=p.order_no AND c.sub_order_no=p.sub_order_no LEFT JOIN ( SELECT platform,order_no,sub_order_no,SUM(amount) AS cash FROM cps_recon_source WHERE source_type='UNION_RECEIPT' GROUP BY platform,order_no,sub_order_no ) r ON r.platform=p.platform AND r.order_no=p.order_no AND r.sub_order_no=p.sub_order_no WHERE p.credited > 0 AND p.platform=#{platform} ORDER BY p.platform,p.order_line_id
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(-balance),0) FROM sys_agent_commission_account WHERE balance < 0

SELECT id,platform_type,order_id,sub_order_no,actual_commission FROM sys_order_commission WHERE platform_type=#{platform} AND actual_commission IS NOT NULL AND ((settle_time >= #{from} AND settle_time < #{until}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cps_recon_source s WHERE s.platform=sys_order_commission.platform_type AND s.order_no=sys_order_commission.order_id AND s.sub_order_no=sys_order_commission.sub_order_no AND s.source_type IN ('UNION_REPORT','UNION_RECEIPT') AND s.occurred_on >= #{from} AND s.occurred_on < #{until})) ORDER BY id

SELECT business_id AS withdraw_no,SUM(CASE WHEN credit_account='PAYOUT' THEN ABS(amount) ELSE -ABS(amount) END) AS amount FROM sys_commission_flow WHERE business_id IS NOT NULL AND (credit_account='PAYOUT' OR debit_account='PAYOUT') AND ((create_time >= #{from} AND create_time < #{until}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cps_withdrawal w WHERE w.withdraw_no=sys_commission_flow.business_id AND w.status='SUCCEEDED' AND w.completed_at >= #{from} AND w.completed_at < #{until}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cps_recon_source s WHERE s.platform='PAYOUT' AND s.source_type='PAYOUT' AND s.withdraw_no=sys_commission_flow.business_id AND s.occurred_on >= #{from} AND s.occurred_on < #{until})) GROUP BY business_id ORDER BY business_id

SELECT withdraw_no,amount FROM cps_withdrawal WHERE status='SUCCEEDED' AND ((completed_at >= #{from} AND completed_at < #{until}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cps_recon_source s WHERE s.platform='PAYOUT' AND s.source_type='PAYOUT' AND s.withdraw_no=cps_withdrawal.withdraw_no AND s.occurred_on >= #{from} AND s.occurred_on < #{until}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys_commission_flow f WHERE f.business_id=cps_withdrawal.withdraw_no AND (f.credit_account='PAYOUT' OR f.debit_account='PAYOUT') AND f.create_time >= #{from} AND f.create_time < #{until})) ORDER BY withdraw_no
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cps_recon_batch(platform,period,status,fingerprint,diff_count,created_at) VALUES(#{platform},#{period},'RUNNING',#{fingerprint},0,UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=id
mapper.select: SELECT id,platform,period,status,fingerprint,diff_count,created_at,completed_at FROM cps_recon_batch WHERE fingerprint=#{fingerprint} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE cps_recon_batch SET status='COMPLETED',diff_count=#{diffCount},completed_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND status='RUNNING'
mapper.select: SELECT config_value FROM sys_config WHERE config_key=#{key}
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(amount),0) FROM cps_exposure_snapshot WHERE platform=#{platform}
